description: Dispatch a keyboard key (keydown/keypress/keyup) — Enter to submit, Escape to close, Tab to move focus. Without a selector it goes to whatever currently has focus, like a real keyboard. Like qa_click, it returns what changed once the page settled. On a recent extension build the reply also carries `focus` — the element that ACTUALLY holds focus after the key (name, role, selector, box), which is how you follow a Tab route or catch focus landing somewhere unnamed — and `announced`, what the live regions spoke (null = they stayed silent). Requires the one-time “Agent control” confirmation in the panel; without it the extension answers consent-required and does nothing.

frameId.description: Which frame to ask, from qa_frames. Omit for the page itself. A payment form, an SSO step or an embedded widget usually lives in a frame of its own, and a cross-origin one can only be read from inside it.

ref.description: Optional target (a qa_snapshot ref); defaults to the focused element

selector.description: Optional target (CSS); defaults to the focused element

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_press
title: Press a key
